notes: Notes, reminders and tasks actually run now. The app closes properly, updates leave nothing behind, and the update screen lives in Settings.

changelog.headline: What's new in 1.0.6

sections.title: Tools and memory
items: Notes, reminders, tasks, portfolio and the rest actually run now. The installed app had been shipping without its tool list, so it would reply as if it had done something without anything happening.
Memory works properly again, since it relies on those same tools.

sections.title: Closing and updating
items: There is a quit button in the top bar and in Settings. Closing the app now really closes it, with nothing left running in the background.
Updates no longer leave old copies of the app running after they finish.
The error box that appeared after an update is gone.

sections.title: Settings
items: Software update has its own section in Settings, with what changed, the download size and an automatic update switch.
About shows real details instead of placeholder text.

changelog.data_safety: Your chats, memory, notes, portfolio and settings stay exactly as they are. This update only replaces the app's own program files. Nothing you have created is touched or deleted.
